body.condition:
With \(\mathcal X=\sigma((X_{uv})_{1\le u\le S,\ 1\le v\le T})\), every \(s,t,i\) satisfies
\[
 \mathbb E[Q_{sti}\mid z_0,\mathcal X]=m_s(X_{st})
\]
and every \(s,i\) satisfies
\[
 \mathbb E[B_{si}^{\mathrm{obs}}\mid z_0,\mathcal X]
 =\mathbb E[B_{si}^{\mathrm{obs}}\mid z_0]
 =\mu_{1s}(z_0)
\]
almost surely.
